summary: Asia Pacific Wire & Cable Corporation Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 14, 2026 press release reporting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held September 11, 2026, where shareholders approved all proposed resolutions. Management reviewed H1 2026 results: revenue rose 17.6% year-over-year to US$267.5 million, EBITDA margin improved to 4.56% from 1.66%, and cash reached US$64.6 million after a Q1 2026 rights offering. The presentation also covered Singapore power infrastructure projects, expansion into energy storage and EPC services, and potential North American investment. This is a routine AGM/meeting reminder with corporate updates, not a special situation.
